scope: Read-only integration review; compute-budget derivation and scientific protocol independently reviewed by root agent. Resource helper authored by this reviewer; host/supervisor integration independently read.

fixed_findings.initial_gap: Environment binding self-validation lacked equality with supervisor and launch receipts.
fixed_findings.resolution: host.runtime_reservation now checks all three before original worker entry; reviewer read final source.

checks.finding: Supervisor admits actual free >=46080 MiB; resource target is fixed from launch free minus1024 MiB, bounded45056..73728 MiB. Worker reserves before the unchanged v049 loader. Private available_cards binding credits only exact own PID/UUID pre-reservation; the original measured sample is not mutated.

Runtime compares environment reservation to supervisor state and pre-Popen launch record, GPU index/UUID, exact worker command, source cwd, original worker and planned units before CUDA/model load. The initially missing cross-record agreement was independently confirmed and host agent added runtime_reservation.

Resource wrapper invokes original bound learning_logprobs/_generate_tokens exactly once with unchanged arguments/results. Temporary uint8 allocations are released before calls; no explicit empty_cache/manual_seed/synchronize. Post-forward hook only reads counters, so it cannot hold ballast while backward awaits. Original update/collection and RNG guards remain.

Pure preload capacity/OOM wait writes reservation_wait; supervisor bypasses task-time guard for this kind but retains RSS. Disk, PID/GPU telemetry and telemetry120s grace remain. Success writes a fresh loading time. Training-compute receipt is not created until update preparation, so resource wait has no training-time debit; worker walltime still includes it.

Actual supervisor passes own_memory_limit_mib=None; TelemetryGuard explicitly skips only own-memory limit when None. No live_free_stop_reason dispatch, no60s stability gate, no3resident gate. Query executor uses len(active); distinct physical cards and scientific dependencies govern dispatch.

Inventory is one Q_minus recomputation plus eight Q_plus and eight Q_minus single-slot development workers. Integer index//4 maps original shard and index%4 maps original unit. Q_plus dev waits exact external completion; Q_minus dev waits local complete update. No old collection/B/S_star development/update-Q_plus is admitted.

Observer delegates read-only r2 observation against original r1. External GPU excluded until exact completion and process exit. Only r3 Popen workers enter active; request_stop enforces owned name/PID/state; inherited stop checks start_ticks then stops the owned process group created with start_new_session=True. No external/foreign process signal path found.

Only pre-model allocation OOM is retried. Postload/native resource or model OOM propagates as execution error. Training supervisor now preserves30s reclamation reserve only for unfinished compute receipts and uses actual ended_at for completed receipts; this does not apply to reservation_wait without compute receipt.

limitations: No real CUDA allocator/model execution was performed in this review; reusable reservation is a resource strategy, not a guarantee against subsequent OOM.
No source edit was made by this review; reviewed hashes must be rechecked if the files change.
Existing CPU test source was read; test results are separately recorded and were not rerun for this review.
